# Via (Chartavia)

> Via is the scripting language of Chartavia (chartavia.com) for chart indicators and trading experts with backtests. English and Arabic keywords. Not Pine Script.

Read llms-full.txt (or ai/via-for-ai.md) for the complete reference, rules and checked examples. Check scripts with `node tools/check.cjs file.via --run`.

## Docs

- [Complete kit for AI](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/ai/via-for-ai.md): everything in one file

## Examples

- [two-averages](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/basics/two-averages.via): Two moving averages with cross marks
- [rsi-zones](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/basics/rsi-zones.via): RSI with zones and colored line
- [bands-squeeze](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/basics/bands-squeeze.via): Volatility bands with squeeze highlight
- [macd-columns](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/basics/macd-columns.via): MACD with colored histogram
- [trailing-trend](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/basics/trailing-trend.via): ATR trailing trend line (uses keep)
- [arabic](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/basics/arabic.via): A full script written in Arabic
- [swing-structure](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/basics/swing-structure.via): Swing structure with zones and a panel (Via 0.2)
- [gann-two-points](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/basics/gann-two-points.via): Gann angles from two points you pick on the chart
- [expert-average-cross](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/basics/expert-average-cross.via): Expert: trade the average cross
- [expert-rsi-reversion](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/basics/expert-rsi-reversion.via): Expert: RSI mean reversion with stop and target
- [expert-breakout](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/basics/expert-breakout.via): Expert: channel breakout with ATR stop
- [anchored-vwap-from-date](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/anchored-vwap-from-date.via): Anchored VWAP and range from a date you pick on a calendar
- [arabic-rsi-alerts](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/arabic-rsi-alerts.via): An indicator written fully in Arabic keywords: RSI with zones, marks and alerts
- [auto-fibonacci](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/auto-fibonacci.via): Automatic Fibonacci retracement of the last swing, redrawn on the newest bar
- [average-of-your-choice](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/average-of-your-choice.via): One moving average, with its type picked from a list in the settings
- [average-ribbon](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/average-ribbon.via): Moving-average ribbon that changes colour with the trend
- [candle-patterns](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/candle-patterns.via): Classic candle patterns: engulfing, hammer, shooting star and inside bar
- [daily-average-any-timeframe](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/daily-average-any-timeframe.via): A moving average of daily closes that you can see on any intraday chart
- [fair-value-gaps](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/fair-value-gaps.via): Fair value gaps (three-candle imbalances) drawn as boxes that disappear once filled
- [gann-angles-two-points](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/gann-angles-two-points.via): Gann angles from two points you pick on the chart: the fan, the star and the price box
- [heikin-ashi-trend](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/heikin-ashi-trend.via): Heikin Ashi trend: colours the normal candles by the smoothed Heikin Ashi direction
- [market-dashboard](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/market-dashboard.via): A small dashboard in the chart corner: trend, RSI, ADX, volatility and today's change
- [previous-day-levels](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/previous-day-levels.via): Yesterday's high, low and close, today's open and last week's range on any intraday chart
- [session-ranges](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/session-ranges.via): Asia, London and New York session ranges as boxes
- [structure-breaks](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/structure-breaks.via): Market structure: break of structure (BOS) and change of character (CHoCH) from swing points
- [supply-demand-zones](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/supply-demand-zones.via): Supply and demand zones: the candle before a strong move, kept until price closes through it
- [support-resistance-lines](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/support-resistance-lines.via): Support and resistance lines from recent swings, extended to the right
- [swing-labels](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/swing-labels.via): Swing highs and lows labelled HH, LH, HL and LL
- [trend-pullback-alerts](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/trend-pullback-alerts.via): Alerts for pullbacks inside a trend: RSI dips and recovers while the 50 average is above the 200
- [volume-spikes](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/indicators/volume-spikes.via): Volume columns with unusual spikes highlighted
- [average-cross-atr-stop](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/experts/average-cross-atr-stop.via): Moving-average cross with an ATR stop and a target at a multiple of the risk (longs and shorts)
- [bands-reversion](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/experts/bands-reversion.via): Mean reversion on volatility bands: buy back inside the lower band, sell back inside the upper, exit at the middle
- [breakeven-stop](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/experts/breakeven-stop.via): Trend entries that move the stop to breakeven after one unit of risk, with a time exit
- [channel-breakout-trailing](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/experts/channel-breakout-trailing.via): Channel breakout with a trailing ATR stop that only moves in the trade's favour (longs only)
- [risk-based-size](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/experts/risk-based-size.via): Position size from risk: each trade risks a fixed percent of equity at its stop
- [session-breakout](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/experts/session-breakout.via): Opening-range breakout: trade the break of the first hour of the London session, close by session end
- [supertrend-flip](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/experts/supertrend-flip.via): SuperTrend expert: always in the market, flips long and short when the SuperTrend line flips
- [time-filtered-macd](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/examples/experts/time-filtered-macd.via): MACD crosses traded only on chosen weekdays and hours, flat before the weekend

## Optional

- [Community library](https://github.com/mohamadmahdy9/chartavia-plugin/blob/main/docs/cookbook.md#community-library-classic-studies-mit--مكتبة-المجتمع-مؤشرات-كلاسيكية-mit): 41 classic studies
